evidenceVaultRecovery.rootCause: Immutable Evidence Vault attachment metadata is reserved prior to Storage upload. Provider duplicate/lost success responses may strand an attachment and cause non-idempotent retries.
evidenceVaultRecovery.fix: On upload error, private download of same tenant/object path with no-store; compare SHA-256 and exact size of stored bytes to original. Only matching bytes are accepted. Otherwise preserve original upload error. No upsert, no relaxation of RLS, no schema migration.
